t: From The Heart: Embracing Slow Fashion with Osha's Vibrant Designs – sienna.co

I couldn’t stand the idea of it going to waste so I designed a print that incorporated the marks and loved the results!” Bilboa customers have the option to add a choice of Osha’s print designs to any of her fabric bases, creating uniquely individual garments.
